title: Avocado with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- avocado outer skin: dark green pear shape -->
  <path d='M50 8 C66 8 78 22 78 40 C78 55 74 68 66 78 C60 85 55 90 50 90 C45 90 40 85 34 78 C26 68 22 55 22 40 C22 22 34 8 50 8 Z' fill='#3f7d2e'/>
  <!-- lighter rim for edge definition -->
  <path d='M50 12 C64 12 74 24 74 40 C74 53 70 65 63 74 C58 80 54 85 50 85 C46 85 42 80 37 74 C30 65 26 53 26 40 C26 24 36 12 50 12 Z' fill='#5aa832'/>
  <!-- avocado flesh: light yellow-green -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='19' ry='32' fill='#d7e86b'/>
  <!-- flesh shading on edges -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='19' ry='32' fill='none' stroke='#b8d24a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- pit: warm brown -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='11' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#a9743c' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- face on the flesh above pit -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#2b3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#2b3a1a'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='43.2' cy='38.8' r='1.1' fill='#f4ffd0'/>
  <circle cx='59.2' cy='38.8' r='1.1' fill='#f4ffd0'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='47' r='3.4' fill='#f2a3a3'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='47' r='3.4' fill='#f2a3a3'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M42 48 Q50 56 58 48' fill='none' stroke='#2b3a1a' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
